title.narrative: Basic Infrastructure for Inclusive Growth in the North Central Provinces Sector Project

description.narrative:
The project impact will accelerate socio-economic development of the four north central provinces (NCPs) in accordance with the Provincial Socio-economic Development Plans through 2020, with a vision to 2030 (PSEDP) and the Master Plan on Socio-economic Development of Viet Nam's Central Northern and Coastal Region through to 2020 (Master Plan). The project outcome will be service delivery in the four NCPs of Viet Nam of Ha Tinh, Nghe An, Quang Binh, Quang Tri improved.
The proposed project will (i) rehabilitate and upgrade provincial road and district roads in the NCPs; (ii) support productive and business infrastructure including water supply networks, sea and river protection and drainage works with association river transport infrastructure, and supporting flood and irrigation command areas; and (iii) establish decentralized public asset management processes and established for road, water supply and irrigation infrastructure.
The project will have an Asian Development Bank (ADB) sector modality and implement in total approximately 32 subprojects for outputs 1 and 2. Feasibility Studies (FS) have been prepared for the four representative subprojects demonstrating subproject viability, and consequently overall project feasibility. Criteria for the eligibility, election, prioritization and preparation of additional subprojects have been agreed. A long list of additional subprojects has been identified, and the NCPs and ADB will carry out field screening to agree upon their inclusion in the project.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Productive infrastructure for business development improved Indicator: Two rural domestic water supply schemes consisting of 377 km of pipelines constructed (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 2a. Being achieved. Water supply network of about 377 km of pipelines in Ha Tinh (HT01.1) almost completed. HT01.1: 140.804 km HT01.2: 237.089 km Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Actual value:

Output: Transport infrastructure improved Indicator: 25 training programs, one for each road subproject, provided to vulnerable road users on each of the road subprojects, targeting women and children, with female road users accounting for 50% of participants (2017 baseline 0) Progress/Status: 1c. Achieved (this gender related indicator coincides with GAP T3). 42 comprehensive training programs were conducted with 6,360 local people and pupils, including 3,360 female participants (52.8%).
Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Actual value:

Output: Transport infrastructure improved Indicator: Traffic-calming measures provided to all 25 road sections passing schools, markets, medical facilities, and administrative centers (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 1b. Being achieved. Traffic-calming measures have been implemented in all road sections. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Actual value:

Output: Decentralized public asset management processes established Indicator: Asset planning system for road infrastructure established and populated in each NCP (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 3a. Conventional system is used and will be assessed at project completion. Processes are being established, and component's activities are integrated in the government's program and not under project control. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Decentralized public asset management processes established Indicator: Decentralized irrigation infrastructure asset management systems established in each NCP (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 3c. See above. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Decentralized public asset management processes established Indicator: Water supply asset planning with supporting databases for business management reporting for two water supply schemes completed (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 3b. See above. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2026 Target value: Y

Output: Productive infrastructure for business development improved Indicator: 27 km of dikes, embankments, and canals constructed (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 2b. Being achieved. Contract NA03: 29.62 km of dikes awarded, almost completed. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2026 Target value: 27 km

Output: Productive infrastructure for business development improved Indicator: At least one dock upgraded to port type 1 standard and included washroom facilities dedicated for women's use (2017 baseline: unclassified port type) Progress/Status: 2c. Being achieved. Gianh River dock is being upgraded (Quang Binh). Washroom facilities for women's use was designed in the port DED. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Unclassified port Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Unclassified port Target year: 2026 Target value: Type 1 standard dock

Output: Productive infrastructure for business development improved Indicator: At least one water reservoir upgraded for irrigation and domestic consumption (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 2d. Being achieved. (Ha Tinh province). Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2026 Target value: At least 1

Output: Transport infrastructure improved Indicator: About 214 km of district roads upgraded (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: 1a. For attention. Delayed contracts in Quang Tri, Nghe An and Quang Binh due to complicated LAR may result in DMF changes. Pending issues to be followed up in 2026, along with LCD extension. Data Source: PPMS and QPRs Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2026 Target value: 214 km
Service delivery in north central provinces (NCPs) improved

10,100 households with 50% female received clean water (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: c. Achieved. (HT01).
Achieved (gender target coincides with GAP T5). About 13,000 households (~52,000 people-beneficiaries) with about 50% female beneficiaries are expected to receive clean water by 2026 when the constructed water supply facilities will be fully operational. Data Source: PPMS, annual provincial public health reports Target value: 10,100 households Actual value:

33 communes consisting of 13,000 ha protected from flood and sea level rise (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: d. Achieved
Assessment made vs revised indicator at LCD extension: 33 communes and 13,009.54 ha achieved. No. of communes to be verified and updated at project completion due to government restructuring. Data Source: PPMS, PPC annual report Target value: 33 communes Actual value:

Dock capacity increased to 17,000 tons of aquatic products per year (2017 baseline: 6,800 tons of aquatic products per year) Progress/Status: e. Achieved. One dock is being upgraded to increase its capacity as envisaged (Gianh River dock in Quang Binh). Data Source: Provincial annual reports and socioeconomic development plans Actual value:

6.3% average annual increase in movement of goods (ton-km) on improved roads (2016 baselines: 3.1 ton-km) Progress/Status: b. To assess at project completion. Data Source: PPMS, government and public transport operator statistics Baseline value: 3.1 ton-km

7.7% average annual increase in passenger car unit (PCU) on improved roads (2016 baselines: 0.71 million PCU) Progress/Status: a. For attention. Incomplete connectivity is foreseen and will impact PCU and movement of goods due to: - Late approval of connection to highway and BOT roads (QB01.1 and QB04 in former Quang Binh), and National Rd. No. 9 (QT01 and QT05 in Quang Tri) resulted from changes of Government's policies and transport master plan. - Unresolved long pending resettlement cases at these connection points by LCD. - LCD extension to 31 December 2026 being processed to achieve output and outcome. Target dates were updated, LCD extension memo to be provided upon request. Data Source: PPMS, government and public transport operator statistics Baseline value: 0.71 million PCU

Asset management data for provincially owned road and irrigation infrastructure integrated into annual provincial reports and development plans (2017 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: f. For attention and to be further assessed at project completion. Corresponding component 3's activities integrated into government programs separate from project. Data Source: Provincial annual reports and socioeconomic development plans Base year: 2017 Baseline value: N
